data.name: Mustafa
data.gender_notes: Mustafa is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ص-ف-و (ṣ-f-w), 'to choose, purify'. Muṣṭafā means 'the chosen one'. Its root is ص-ف-و (ṣ-f-w). An epithet of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Mustafa is a Arabic name meaning “Chosen one; selected”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mustafa expresses “Chosen one; selected”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ص-ف-و (ṣ-f-w), 'to choose, purify'. Muṣṭafā means 'the chosen one'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustafa total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
